create_dynamic_rendezvous_handler: create a DynamicRendezvousHandler using create_handler with a store, backend, and RendezvousParameters
build_dynamic_rendezvous_from_backend: build a DynamicRendezvousHandler using from_backend with run_id, store, backend, min_nodes, and max_nodes
run_next_rendezvous: run the next rendezvous round on DynamicRendezvousHandler to join and get store, rank, and world_size
test_set_closed: test the DynamicRendezvousHandler.set_closed method to close the rendezvous and prevent new nodes from joining
review_shutdown: review the DynamicRendezvousHandler.shutdown method to stop heartbeats and close the rendezvous
